correctness.rationale: The published lower bound gives \(H^*(n)\ge10\) at five-prime support. For each \(h\in\{10,11,12,13\}\), ordering the five prime-power components and using monotonicity of \(x/(x+1)\) yields a finite exact bound at every recursive branch; the fifth component is then forced by \(x=T/(P-T)\). Exact replay returns no cases for \(10,11,12\) and precisely \(5460,8190\) for \(13\), with direct substitution.
